diagnostic.scope: Recovered lifecycle only; source-owned farheap/error callbacks. Counts0..128; no heap manager, full loader, or ASPECT VM claim.

source_only_checks.tested_counts: 0..128 only; malformed values deliberately not executed
source_only_checks.native_malformed_behavior: Stores complete read AX and signed JG; FFFF is negative and skips loops; byte255 exceeds128-slot table. No bounds check or rollback. Release retains pointers/count; repeated release is unsafe.
source_only_checks.scope: Recovered routines execute unmodified with source-owned read/farheap/error callbacks. Error-return and stop-at-error are separate diagnostic models, not real error101/longjmp recovery. Real heap, loader and VM remain outside scope.

limitations: Recovered native allocation/release primitives, not a complete loader or VM.
DOS and CPU use declared heap/error callback substitutes.
No original heap manager, error UI or nonlocal unwind is exercised.
No rollback, bounds validation or idempotent release is implied.
